Model introspection

Source: R/robot-model.R
robot_introspection.Rd

robot_dof() returns the number of independent degrees of freedom (the number of movable joints). robot_joints() returns a data frame of all joints in traversal order; q_index gives the position of each movable joint in configuration vectors. robot_joint_names() returns the names of movable joints in configuration order. robot_links() returns a data frame of links with inertial summaries. robot_frames() returns all frame names (one per link). robot_limits() returns a matrix of position limits with one row per degree of freedom.

robot_dof(robot)

robot_joints(robot)

robot_joint_names(robot)

robot_links(robot)

robot_frames(robot)

robot_limits(robot)

Arguments

robot

A robot_model.

Value

An integer, data frame, character vector or matrix.

Examples

robot <- robot_example("planar2")
robot_dof(robot)
#> [1] 2
robot_joints(robot)
#>          name     type parent child q_index     lower    upper
#> joint1 joint1 revolute   base link1       1 -3.141593 3.141593
#> joint2 joint2 revolute  link1 link2       2 -3.141593 3.141593
robot_limits(robot)
#>            lower    upper
#> joint1 -3.141593 3.141593
#> joint2 -3.141593 3.141593
